about.title: About
bio: Motorsport wasn't where I started. I'd been photographing landscapes and wildlife for years — then I stood at my first race weekend and understood I'd be back. F1, F2, the Porsche Mobil 1 Supercup: I go where I can, and I go on my own terms. Shooting for myself taught me the thing I keep: I bring a point of view to a weekend, not just a checklist.

What I'm after is emotion — the tension of a lap that's going wrong, the noise you feel in your chest, the way an entire grandstand leans the same direction at once. That's the picture I want. Everything else is a means to it: smoke, sparks, rain, low sun across the tarmac, a panning frame that's mostly blur. I use whatever carries the feeling of that particular moment, and I'll lose frames trying.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: For assignments and race weekends — write to me directly. I answer within a day.

terms.title: Working together
terms.lead: Tell me the event and what you need covered — I'll come back with a shot list and a price.

items.label: Coverage
list: Pit lane and paddock, where accreditation allows

items.label: Delivery
list: A first selection within hours of the chequered flag
The full edited set, every session booked, within 72 hours

items.label: Usage
list: Your own channels — social, website, presentations: credited, no time limit
Advertising and passing files to third parties: agreed separately

items.label: Travel
items.text: Belgrade-based, shooting worldwide. The fee covers the work; travel and accommodation at cost on top.

terms.note: Briefs welcome — sponsor logos, specific drivers, must-have moments. Send the list and I'll shoot to it.

license.title: Using my photographs
license.lead: Free to use for personal and non-commercial purposes — with my written permission and my name next to the frame. Commissioning a shoot is a different thing: that is paid work.

items.label: Free of charge
items.text: I don't charge for the use of the photographs on this site, and I don't sell them.

items.label: Not for commercial use
items.text: Advertising, resale and any other commercial use of these frames are not covered by the permission I give.

items.label: Ask me first
items.text: Write to me before you publish a frame anywhere, and wait for my answer. Permission is given in writing, by email, and for that use.

items.label: Credit me
items.text: My name — Nadia Stelmashuk — next to the photograph.

items.label: If you're on social media
items.text: Tag me and link to my account when you post — a mention in return for the frame. That is credit, not payment: these frames aren't for sale.

newWork.title: New photographs
newWork.scope: Everything above is about the frames already published here.
newWork.commission: A shoot for your brief is a different matter: the fee and the usage rights — advertising included — are agreed for that particular shoot.
newWork.archive: If you need a frame from a weekend that isn't published here, ask — I'll tell you whether I can give it, and on what terms.

license.how: Either one — email or Instagram. I answer within a day.
